title: Share your location to use Vault
points: Vault sends your location to the administrator each time you open the app. Nothing is sent while the app is closed.
The administrator can see your last 10 locations on a map. Older ones are deleted automatically.
Other Vault users cannot see your location.
Vault needs location to work: if you turn off your phone's location or Vault's location permission, the app stops until you turn it back on.
